facts.image: red line = trace, yellow dot = click; panels: close-up, slice 0, slice 19

text: The automated trace is on the clicked layer and can be trusted as a rough guide, with 78.9% within 5 voxels and a median distance of 2.8 voxels, but only 31.9% within 2 voxels so fine detail is uncertain. It is weakest where only 10 of 20 slices were traced, as seen in slice 19 with no red line, and on slice 0 where the red line drifts off the layer on the left side. A person should check the close-up against the yellow dot click and follow the red line across slice 0 and slice 19 to confirm it stays on the same sheet.
